mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0
